items.description: The retreat of the stock market in recent days shows how President Trump’s push to reinstall the company’s chief executive has collided with the realities of his other policies.

items.title: Nvidia Halts Sales to Southeast Asia as U.S. Tightens China Restrictions
items.description: The shipping halt, which hit four countries, follows a new U.S. rule that would require licenses for companies in the countries to buy advanced A.I. chips.

items.title: Trump Tried to Cripple Huawei. Now It Is Central to China’s A.I. Push.
items.description: As China’s access to Nvidia’s advanced chips shrinks, Huawei is becoming increasingly indispensable to Beijing despite a wide technological gap with its American rival.

items.title: A Rumored $300 Million Score on Nvidia’s Stock Surge Isn’t Backed by Trading Records

items.title: Bipartisan Desire to Regulate A.I. Faces Obstacles in Congress
items.description: Members of both parties say they want to tackle artificial intelligence policy, but the slow pace of legislating and turf battles could stand in the way.

items.title: Lured by High Salaries, Some Brazilians Were Duped Into Fighting for Russia
items.description: Dozens of Brazilians were sent to the front lines with little training, and the high salaries they were promised, they say, turned out to be illusory.

items.title: Brazilian Duped Into Fighting for Russia: ‘War Is Hell’
items.description: Dozens of Brazilians have joined the Russian army, some say lured by a pair of recruiters promising money and adventure. Here is one soldier’s story.

items.title: Net Migration to U.K. Falls to Lowest Level Since 1997, Excluding Pandemic
items.description: The drop was largely driven by fewer people arriving from outside the European Union. It reflects government action to restrict immigration after a public backlash.

items.title: To Many, Turkeys Are Dinner. To These Artists, They’re the Perfect Muse.
items.description: Artists who paint or draw the wild turkey speak of its swagger and charm. Their renderings have helped fund a conservation success story.

items.title: How a Thanksgiving Tradition Connects to Presidential Powers
items.description: As President Trump pardons turkeys for Thanksgiving, our chief White House correspondent Peter Baker takes a look back at the history of the tradition and the presidential power of the pardon.

items.title: How Our Reporters Navigate Politics at Thanksgiving
items.description: A holiday gathering can be joyous. And fraught. Here’s how six reporters deal with their own dinner-table discourse. (And when they switch the topic to serving spoons or animal sex.)

items.title: Gérard Depardieu Is Ordered to Stand Trial Over Rape Accusation
items.description: The actress Charlotte Arnould has accused the French movie star of raping her in 2018. He has denied any wrongdoing in the case.

items.title: Veruschka, One of the World’s First Supermodels, Has Died
items.description: She rocketed to fame in Vogue and other magazines during the Swinging Sixties and had a memorable cameo in Antonioni’s hit film “Blow-Up.” She was 87.
